inlines.v: EXTE'RIOR, adjective [Latin from exterus, foreign.] 1. External; outward; applied to the outside or outer surface of a body, and opposed to interior. We speak of the exterior and interior surfaces of a concavo-convex lens. 2. External; on the outside, with reference to a person; extrinsic. We speak of an object exterior to a man, as opposed to that which is within or in his mind. EXTE'RIOR, noun The outward surface; that which is external. 1. Outward or visible deportment; appearance.
